# American Board

> American Board provides flexible, online teacher certification programs across multiple states and subject areas for career changers and aspiring educators.

American Board specializes in alternative teacher certification through self-paced, online programs. The platform offers subject-specific certifications (Biology, Chemistry, Elementary Education, English Language Arts, Physics) and state-specific pathways with exam preparation support across 15+ states.

## Key Topics

- Online Teacher Certification
- Alternative Certification
- Self-Paced Learning
- Biology Teacher Certification
- Chemistry Teacher Certification
- Elementary Education
- English Language Arts
- Career Transition
- Free Trial Programs
- State-Specific Pathways
- Flexible Enrollment
- Subject-Specific Programs
- Exam Preparation
- Secondary Education
- Teacher Training

## Subject-Specific Certifications

- [Become a Biology Teacher | Biology Teacher Certification with American Board](https://www.americanboard.org/biology): Biology teacher certification with PTK exam and American Board Biology exam
- [Become a Chemistry Teacher | Chemistry Teacher Certification](https://www.americanboard.org/chemistry): Chemistry teacher certification with exam preparation and state requirements
- [Become an Elementary Teacher | Elementary Teacher Certification](https://www.americanboard.org/elementary-education): Elementary teacher certification with PTK and ABCTE Elementary Education exam

## State Certification Programs

- [Become a Teacher in Alabama | Alabama Teacher Certification](https://www.americanboard.org/alabama): Alabama teacher certification program with Biology, Chemistry, ELA options
- [Become a Teacher in Florida | Florida Teacher Certification](https://www.americanboard.org/florida): Florida teacher certification program with Biology, English, Chemistry subjects
- [Become a Teacher in Idaho | Idaho Teacher Certification](https://www.americanboard.org/idaho): Idaho teacher certification with Biology, Chemistry, Physics subject options
- [Become a Teacher in Indiana | Indiana Teacher Certification](https://www.americanboard.org/indiana): Indiana teacher certification program offering Biology, Chemistry, ELA subjects
- [Become a Teacher in Missouri | Missouri Teacher Certification](https://www.americanboard.org/missouri): Missouri teacher certification for Biology, Chemistry, Physics with free trial
- [Become a Teacher in Montana | Montana Teacher Certification](https://www.americanboard.org/montana): Montana state-approved online teacher certification program
- [Become a Teacher in Nebraska | Nebraska Teacher Certification](https://www.americanboard.org/nebraska): Nebraska teacher certification for Biology, Chemistry, ELA with free trial
- [Become a Teacher in North Dakota | North Dakota Teacher Certification](https://www.americanboard.org/north-dakota): North Dakota self-paced online teacher certification program
- [Become a Teacher in Ohio | Ohio Teacher Certification | American Board](https://www.americanboard.org/ohio): Ohio teacher certification with OAE exam preparation and enrollment steps
- [Become a Teacher in Oklahoma | Oklahoma Teacher Certification](https://www.americanboard.org/oklahoma): Oklahoma teacher certification for Biology, Chemistry, Math subjects
- [Become a Teacher in Pennsylvania | Pennsylvania Teacher Certification](https://www.americanboard.org/pennsylvania): Pennsylvania teacher certification with Special Education and Science options
- [Become a Teacher in South Carolina Teacher | Online Teacher Certification](https://www.americanboard.org/south-carolina): South Carolina online teacher certification program with free 7-day trial
- [Become a Teacher in West Virginia | West Virginia Teacher Certification](https://www.americanboard.org/west-virginia): West Virginia teacher certification for Biology, Chemistry, ELA subjects
- [Become a Teacher in Wisconsin | Wisconsin Teacher Certification](https://www.americanboard.org/wisconsin): Wisconsin teacher certification for ELA, Elementary, Social Studies subjects
- [Become a Teacher in Mississippi | Mississippi Teacher Certification](https://www.americanboard.org/mississippi): Mississippi teacher certification with Praxis exam requirements and standards
